name: sidecourt
description: Work on your own SideCourt posts without leaving your editor. It can list your posts, read and edit your private drafts (works and requests), create a new work, request or work + request as a private draft, add small files you choose, read replies and help offers, submit a version you confirmed, and read a public post by link to help. It never publishes, never replies as you, never accepts help for you, and never changes your account.
